13762770050c8e10525db7f4a5440f721422c0b9.translatedText: It controls the rate of change of the gyroscope bias estimate\. If the angular velocity continuously deviates from zero when the physical unit is stationary, first verify the real data and the source of the deviation; increasing this does not guarantee elimination of heading drift\. For now, keep it at 0\.0001\.
